newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse slips, Unilever heads falls.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse slips, Unilever heads falls.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index slipped on Wednesday with agro-industrial company Unilever and Aluworks the main losers, its market report showed.
The index, which rose seven points on Monday, fell back 0.61 points to 353.05 points on Wednesday.
Volume was 1,006,660 shares traded, well up on Monday's meagre 146,010. Offers were just ahead of bids at 2,762,460 compared to 2,239,960.
Unilever (-15 cedis to 760 cedis), Aluworks (-10 to 1,400) and Mechanical Lloyd Co (-1 to 54) were the three losers.
Home Finance Co (+4 to 139) and Metalloplastica Ghana Ltd (+2 to 152) were the only risers.
